## Standing operator rules
Keep commits small so review stays easy. Separate from the main goal, run `redis-dual-write-cutover` between other work, following its nine listed steps in order, one at a time. Before changing retention behavior, attach the expected deletion count to `ledgerly-privacy-impact` and request sign-off from the designated privacy approver. Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya. The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on. can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

## Current objective
Add type annotations to the invoice module. CSV encoding is complete; webhook verification and invoice pagination are superseded/paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Do not modify the unrelated legacy invoice-rounding fixture. Shared `pending_events` batches and `_last_batch` retained processed events. A five-attempt webhook retry decorator re-sent customer emails.

## Recent work
CSV UTF-8 fix passed 186 tests, Ruff, and diff checks. Redis procedure advanced through step 7 successfully. Invoice baseline passed 12 tests; `LineItem` and `build_invoice_lines` were annotated and `compileall` passed. Remaining invoice helpers need review; Redis steps 8–9 remain.
